g.text: an action, always written with its field names: s = start place, g = goal place, t = time step, R = which AGV. Example: <s=W18, g=W22, t=2, R=AGV-3> = AGV-3 drives from W18 to W22 during step 2. s = g means a wait

g.text: A MAPF (multi-agent path finding) solver produces timed paths. The ADG (action dependency graph) turns them into 'who must finish before whom', so AGVs that run early or late still never meet. The examples in each card
